principle_violations.reason: The Order class is handling multiple responsibilities: managing order items and their details, and storing order status. The PaymentProcessor class is handling the payment processing including setting the order status, which could be separate responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the logic of managing order items and status into different classes. Furthermore, create a method within the Order class to update its status instead of letting the PaymentProcessor handle it directly.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
